title: CSharpComponent
description: A Grasshopper C# Script component definition. Output exactly this structure — no prose, no markdown fences, no explanation. Only the raw JSON object.
rules: code is the complete C# source for the Rhino 8 C# Script component, as a single JSON string with escaped newlines. It must contain the using directives, then 'public class Script_Instance : GH_ScriptInstance' written verbatim, then a 'private void RunScript(...)' method holding the logic. Grasshopper finds both by pattern: keep one space either side of the colon and none before the opening parenthesis.

The RunScript signature IS the interface and must match the declared parameters exactly: every declared input as a by-value argument in declaration order, then every declared output as an 'out' argument in declaration order. No other arguments, and no argument that is not a declared parameter. A submission whose signature disagrees is rejected before it is applied.

An input's declared type fixes its C# type in the signature — see csharpTypes. An input with no declared type is 'object'. Access shapes it: item is the bare type, list is List<T>, tree is DataTree<T>.

Outputs take no type — declare only name and access, and write them as 'out object name' (item) or 'out List<object> name' (list). An output's Grasshopper type is taken from whatever value the code assigns it.
Assign every out argument on every code path; C# will not compile otherwise, and an unassigned output is null on the canvas.
Use RhinoCommon for geometry (Rhino.Geometry). Do not use Print to return results — it writes only to the component's separate 'out' text channel. Every result must be assigned to a declared output.
Every input/output name must be a valid C# identifier, must not be a C# keyword, and must be unique within its own list.
No NuGet packages and no '#r' directives — the .NET base class library plus the Rhino/Grasshopper runtime only.
Inputs left unconnected on the canvas are not errors: a reference-typed input arrives null and a value-typed one arrives at its default. Write code that tolerates that for the parameters you declare.

code.description: Full C# source for the component: usings, 'public class Script_Instance : GH_ScriptInstance', and a 'private void RunScript(...)' method.

inputs.description: Input parameters to create on the component. One entry per by-value argument of RunScript, in signature order.

outputs.description: Output parameters to create on the component. One entry per 'out' argument of RunScript, in signature order. Outputs are untyped — name and access only.

name.description: Argument name used inside RunScript. Must be a valid C# identifier.

type.description: Physalia type hint for the input. Fixes the C# type written in the signature — see csharpTypes.

access.description: Data access mode. item is the bare C# type, list is List<T>, tree is DataTree<T>.

name.description: Argument name used inside RunScript. Must be a valid C# identifier.

access.description: Data access mode. Must match the out argument: item is 'out object name', list is 'out List<object> name'.
